title: Paul NDE 22145
content: It was a road trip with a friend. Started in Minneapolis and ended in California. We lost time when we were having lunch with my friend’s uncle. They had not seen each other for years. We were on a different route than we told his uncle. I woke up in intensive care with my uncle (who I hadn’t seen for three years) from northern California. My brother came as soon as he could. My parents were on their own road trip and were in New York. When I was in intensive care they had pulled all of the tubes out of my body. I could not communicate verbally and tried to communicate to my brother. I knew Rick was in heaven and with his words, he sent me back! He might have wanted to be where he was. During the experience, Rick stopped me with a voice that he only used certain times. He said it wasn’t my time. I hovered over my body and saw my teeth or blood on the road.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death A forty five mile per hour head on collision with a semi-truck.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was told I was conscious, but I don't remember anything. But I do know that the semi we ran into was red!
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I lost time when traveling from Rick's to uncle's house.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: No It was my first road trip at nineteen years old.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: It was wonderful. I wish I could have stayed where I was.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told it was not my time.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told it was not my time. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I did not use the seat belt that probable saved my life for two years. For about two years, I thought that it had just been a nightmare. I did not go to my church so much afterward.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I did not use the seat belt that probable saved my life for two years. For about two years, I thought that it had just been a nightmare. I did not go to my church so much afterward. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes It was 1972 and I stayed quiet for a few years.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes No more or less than usual until this year.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The loss of my friends and family.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes But not for some time. I was able to relate only when I started hearing others experiences.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I was unable to be with my friends and Rick’s family to say good bye!
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: I understand that our experiences are all different. Mine seems to be ‘classic’.
